name: Paraswap Augustus V6 uniswapV3SwapCallback missing caller check
one_liner: Yoink was the first to exploit Paraswap Augustus V6's missing callback caller check, pulling 12,479 OPSEC (6.46 WETH) from one approving wallet 11 hours before anyone else; after Paraswap's on-chain message it sent 4.342 ETH (99.8% of its 4.35 ETH net, 67% of the 6.46 ETH sale) to the Safe Paraswap named, and declined to send the rest.
narrative: Yoink tx 0x35a73969... (block 19470561, index 0, 2024-03-19 18:25:35 UTC) is the FIRST call to Augustus V6 uniswapV3SwapCallback (0xfa461e33) that has no Augustus swap above it, in all of blocks 19426044-19482000 (trace_filter, toAddress=Augustus; code first present at 19426044 = 2024-03-13 12:06 UTC; ~56,000 blocks, 2024-03-13 to 2024-03-21). The next such call is 11 h 13 min later (block 19473885, 2024-03-20 05:38:47). No attacker tx, pending or reverted, precedes or shares the block; no direct 0xfa461e33 tx to Augustus is in the 2024-03-19 mempool-dumpster; Yoink's tx is private. So there is no hacker to front-run: Yoink was the first exploiter (it pulled 12,479 OPSEC from one approving wallet 0x0cc396f5 and sold it for 6.46 WETH; paid 99.8% to the builder, then got 4.34 ETH back from the builder). Returns (corrected 2026-10-21): after Paraswap's on-chain message (block 19507521, 2024-03-24T23:00:59Z) Yoink sent 4.342 ETH to the Safe Paraswap named (0x66E90d840D7C4F3473E25dD8ca361747058c6Db0) in tx 0xa1b1ea5033611603f6e8e5ce5d566ad6b9ad1cd69476e37091c0d90c56c04f90 (block 19508275, 2024-03-25T01:33:35Z): 67.2% of the 6.4633 ETH sale, 99.8% of the bot tx's 4.3499 ETH net. Paraswap asked for the remaining ~2.12 ETH and a 10% bounty split; Yoink declined (2.22 ETH went to the validator); no further transfer found to 2024-05-24. The 'whitehat' label (DeFiHackLabs header, Etherscan) is still not supported by the sequence of events: Yoink was the first exploiter and returned its net profit only after being contacted. Later actors (11 h+) are independent, using the same bug with other victims; they did not replay Yoink's calldata. Unknown != none for private txs.

Could you please send the rest?'. Yoink replied on chain (0xa645a615, 0x3d3e7cfe) that it had already repaid its entire profit and 'more than 100% of my profits', and that 2.22 ETH went to the validator at the end of the block ('welcome to try and recover the remaining amount from the validator'). No further Yoink -> Paraswap transfer appears in the Safe's normal and internal tx lists (blocks 19470000-19700000) or in Yoink's EOA tx list to 2024-05-24 (block 19936023). So the return is 4.342 ETH = 67.2% of the 6.4633 ETH sale proceeds (gross), 99.8% of the bot tx's 4.3499 ETH net (99.6% of the 4.3591 ETH block-level net incl. Yoink's second tx), and Paraswap's own message puts the gap at 2.12 ETH. 99.8% of the proceeds went to the coinbase; the builder refunded 4.3369 ETH of that to Yoink (67%) and passed 2.2229 ETH to the proposer.

The builder refund (index 13, 4.3369 ETH) is a block-level remainder: coinbase payments in the block are 6.5484 ETH (tx0 + tx1), proposer got 2.2229 ETH, so the refund also covers Yoink's arbitrage tx1 (net +0.0092 ETH). bot_net = gross - coinbase + refund; with tx1 included the incident's figure is 4.359 ETH.
